title: A record identity that survives an erase: an id made once and kept by the erased file and the merge, so a device can tell its record from a replaced one (gives the A11 cleared-erase key a true lineage)
evidence: Today an erase rebuilds the file from empty, so meta.createdAt becomes the erase time (packages/health-core/src/erase.ts buildErasedFile, migrateFile(null)) and nothing names the record across erases. Readers of meta.createdAt: packages/health-core/src/merge.ts:839 (equal-epoch merge keeps the earlier); packages/health-core/src/chat-history.ts:192 (the chat file's own meta, same rule); packages/health-core/src/migrate.ts:277-281 (fills a missing createdAt from updatedAt or the rows' latest stamp); packages/health-core/src/migrate.ts:301 (anchors the clamp of mutable row stamps); tools/codex-review-include.mjs:24 (sniffs a health record by the field); tools/codex-review.mjs:1144-1147 (pins the scratch record by its creation stamp, re-pinned after an erase recreates it). None in widget-src, ios/engine or app. US-11 AC6 Limits (a replaced record on the same provider)
